# SectionMessage

## Usage

Use `SectionMessage` for a message that belongs to the page and stays there
until it is resolved or dismissed: why a session cannot be booked, a notice
that a report is out of date, a confirmation that survives a scroll. It takes
children, so the message can carry a link or emphasis, and up to two `actions`
after the body.

A section message always says something about state, so it has six styles and
no others. Each style sets the ground to its role's background token and a
default leading icon in the style's icon color. There is no border or side
stripe: the fill and the icon carry the style.

### Appearance guidance

| Appearance | When to use | Default icon |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Primary | The default, for a general message. | `circle-info` |
| Secondary | A plain, neutral notice. | `circle-info` |
| Success | Something went well. | `circle-check` |
| Danger | Something failed and needs attention. | `circle-exclamation` |
| Warning | A caution before something goes wrong. | `triangle-exclamation` |
| Info | Something worth knowing. | `circle-info` |

## Best practices

### Match the appearance to the meaning. {#match-the-appearance-to-the-meaning}

Warning for a caution; danger only when something failed.

Do: Warning for a provisional schedule.
Don't: Danger for a caution.

### Add a title only when the body needs a heading. {#add-a-title-only-when-the-body-needs-a-heading}

A short body speaks for itself.

Do: A short body, no title.
Don't: A title that repeats the body.

### Dismiss only what is optional. {#dismiss-only-what-is-optional}

A blocking message stays until the problem is fixed. `dismissible` is on by
default, so turn it off when the message must stay.

Do: A blocking error cannot be dismissed.
Don't: A blocking error that can be dismissed.

### Replace the icon through icon, not the children. {#replace-the-icon-through-icon-not-the-children}

A Font Awesome Free solid name or a node replaces the default; `false` removes
it. An icon in the children adds a second one, in the text.

Do: icon replaces the default icon.
Don't: An icon in the children, beside the default one.

### Put field errors on the field. {#put-field-errors-on-the-field}

An error about one input belongs to that input's own error state, such as
`TextField`'s `isInvalid` and `errorMessage`, not in a section message above it.

A rejected submit is the exception that proves the rule: a danger section
message at the top of the form says what was refused, and each field named
still shows its own error.

### Dismissal is one-way. {#dismissal-is-one-way}

The component keeps its own dismissed state, and `show` is not a prop. To bring
a message back when it genuinely changes, remount it with a new `key`.

## Accessibility

- **It announces assertively.** The message renders `role="alert"`, which
  implies `aria-live="assertive"`, so a screen reader interrupts to read it.
  That is right for something that just went wrong and wrong for ambient
  information; for the latter, prefer plain text on the page.
- **A message rendered on mount may not be announced at all.** Live regions
  announce changes. If the message is present in the first paint, treat it as
  ordinary content and make sure the surrounding page still reads correctly.
- **`title` renders as a real heading**, at `headingLevel` (default `h2`). It
  joins the page's outline, so pick the level that fits where it sits.
- **The dismiss button is labeled `Dismiss message`**, hard-coded. It is the
  shared `CloseButton`: a fixed 24×24 target whose × is `aria-hidden`.
- **Say the meaning in the words.** The leading icon is `aria-hidden` and there
  is no text prefix, so `appearance="danger"` on its own does not say "error"
  to a screen reader. The icon differs in shape per style, so danger and
  warning do not rely on color alone to look different.
- **Links keep the text color.** A link in the body is told from the text by
  its underline alone.

## Related

- For validation on a single field, put the message on the field, as `TextField` does.
- For a transient confirmation, use `Flag`.
- For something that must be acknowledged before continuing, use `Modal`.
- For a status label on a row, use `StatusTag`.

Same group: `Banner` · `EmptyState` · `Flag` · `InlineMessage` · `Modal` · `Spotlight`

## Parts

1. **Leading icon.** The appearance glyph on the first line, decorative.
2. **Title.** An optional heading; set `headingLevel` to fit the outline.
3. **Description.** What the person needs to act. A link in it keeps the text color and is underlined.
4. **Actions.** Link buttons, separated by a divider.
5. **Dismiss.** The shared CloseButton, centered on the first line.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | The fill and icon of the appearance, text in the default color. |
| Hovered | The message does not react; Dismiss takes the subtle hovered step. |
| Pressed | Dismiss takes the subtle pressed step. |
| Focused | Dismiss and each action show the 2px ring. |
| Disabled | Not supported. |
| Dismissed | The message is removed and the page keeps no copy. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Write a title that states the issue or the reason for the message. | Repeat a field's error here; say it once. |
| Keep the description to what the person needs to act. | Explain background the person does not need. |
| Write actions as verbs: "Reschedule", "Get help". | Use "click here" as link text. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `id` | string | — | Unique identifier for the section message element |
| `appearance` | enum | `'primary'` | Visual appearance |
| `title` | string | — | Optional title/heading for the message |
| `headingLevel` | enum | — | Heading level the title renders as, 1 through 6. Defaults to `h2`. |
| `children` | node (required) | — | Message content - supports text, JSX, or React components |
| `icon` | bool or string or node | `true` | Leading icon on the first line: `true` for the style's default, a Font Awesome solid name or a node to replace it, `false` to remove it. Always decorative. |
| `actions` | arrayOf (required) | — | Link-button actions after the body, in the order given. Avoid more than two. |
| `dismissible` | bool | `true` | Whether the message can be dismissed |
| `onDismiss` | func | — | Callback when the message is dismissed |
| `className` | string | `''` | Additional CSS classes |
